Title: Azure Data Factory
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/azure-data-factory
Content: The Solidatus Azure Data Factory Connector application is a Java based tool to connect to a Microsoft Azure Data Factory, and extract its Linked Services, Datasets, Pipelines and Dataflows. It is capable of creating attributes for supported Linked Services and Datasets, along with transitions to represent the Pipelines and Dataflows that depend on them.
Title: Usage
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/azure-data-factory/usage
Content: Description

Running the Azure Data Factory Connector in Standalone mode will run one execution of the Connector with the specified configuration options and then stop. The output model will be named and published to the host Solidatus site according to the options provided as command line parameters. Any command line arguments not passed will be set to default arguments (Null or empty).

Example

Command line execution example:

export AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID={AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID}
java -jar solidatus-azure-data-factory-0.0.1.jar \
--solidatus.api.host={$SOLIDATUS_HOST} \
--solidatus.api.token={$SOLIDATUS_TOKEN} \
--solidatus.api.model-name="Azure Data Factory Model" \
--solidatus.azure.client-id={CLIENT_ID} \
--solidatus.azure.client-secret={CLIENT_SECRET} \
--solidatus.azure.tenant-id={TENANT_ID} \
--solidatus.azure.resource-group={RESOURCE_GROUP} \
--solidatus.azure.factory-name={FACTORY_NAME}

Title: Troubleshooting
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.1/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/azure-data-factory/troubleshooting
Content: Please provide the valid required Azure credentials.
Not all Azure credentials have been provided.
Please ensure that solidatus.azure.client-id, solidatus.azure.client-secret, solidatus.azure.tenant-id, solidatus.azure.resource-group, solidatus.azure.factory-name and the Azure subscription ID have been provided.
Failed to save model.
Depending on the error code, the Solidatus credentials could be incorrect or have insufficient permissions (403), or the Solidatus instance may be unavailable.
Ensure you are able to connect to your Solidatus instance, and verify you have permission to CreateModel.
Tried to create transition between x and y but couldn't
This warning means a particular Data Factory object interacts with an object not imported in the model. This commonly happens if you filter a resource such as Datasets without filtering Piplelines/DataFlows that may depend on that Dataset. Otherwise, you may have insufficient permissions to view the resource required to create the model. The result is that the connector is unable to create valid transitions between relevant objects, as they do not exist in the model.
Check your configuration for filters on Azure Data Factory resources. Loosening or removing the filter will help resolve these issues. Otherwise, consult your Azure Data Factory administrator for help on resources you may not have access to.
